units.subsidence_cm: cm (LOS, negative = subsidence, from p01 6 km N of Terra Bella in points.json)
units.soil_moisture: m^3/m^3 (volumetric soil moisture, Central Valley bbox mean from NISAR L3 SME2)
units.hv_backscatter_db: dB (10*log10(sigma0_HV) from NISAR L3 SME2 frequencyA)
units.irrigation_index: 0-1 normalized composite of volumetric soil moisture and HV crop canopy backscatter

source: NISAR L3 SME2 (PROVISIONAL, CRID P05023, track 34 ascending frame 20, 200 m EASE-Grid 2.0) + NISAR L2 GUNW cumulative subsidence (PC3 points.json)
notes: Bbox [-120.2, 35.6, -119.0, 36.6] mean volumetric soil moisture (grids/soilMoisture, 0 < sm <= 0.6 m^3/m^3, ~287k valid 200 m pixels per date) and L-band HV radar backscatter (grids/radarData/frequencyA/sigma0HV in dB). Peak surface moisture (0.184 m^3/m^3 on 2026-07-10 and 0.175 m^3/m^3 with peak HV crop canopy -18.17 dB on 2026-08-15) coincides with active summer irrigation and rapid groundwater drawdown, while late-summer dry-down (0.159 m^3/m^3 by 2026-09-20) accompanies cumulative LOS subsidence reaching -7.8 cm by 2026-10-14.
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
